description: This PHP source file defines the InterviewerUserRole class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling user role permissions related to accessing various recruitment and interview-related entities such as candidates, interviews, attachments, and candidate histories. It includes methods that retrieve accessible IDs for these entities based on the interviewer's permissions.

classes.name: InterviewerUserRole
classes.description: Represents a user role for interviewers with methods to access entity IDs like candidates, interviews, attachments, and history, filtered based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns IDs for a given entity type that the interviewer has access to, based on their permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs accessible to the interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs accessible to the interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewAttachmentIds
methods.description: Retrieves interview attachment IDs accessible to the interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history IDs accessible to the interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyIds
methods.description: Retrieves vacancy IDs accessible to the interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate action history IDs accessible to the interviewer.
